name: AC4.1 cancelling a Recorded request withdraws it after a yes and says so
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, say: "Cancel those trucks for the 104 job, I don't need them anymore." If it asks which request, say the trucks. If it asks whether to withdraw or cancel it, say yes. After it answers, ask: "So it's cancelled?" After it answers, say thanks, goodbye.
success_conditions: The agent asks whether to withdraw the tri-axle dump trucks at Route 104 Widening before calling withdraw_request.
The agent calls withdraw_request once, only after the Foreman said yes, with ref R-1042.
The agent does not take a new request and calls neither submit_requests nor amend_request.
After withdraw_request returns applied true, the agent says it has withdrawn it.
The agent never says the office, a coordinator or anyone else has seen it, been told or will act on it.
The agent never says whether trucks or anything else is available, never gives a time when anything will arrive, be done or be decided, and never states a decision other than what the tools returned.
